name: A Google Doc of this page
title: A Google Doc of this page: a page open on the canvas made into a Google Doc, with its headings, lists, tables and links, and kept in step on the next press, from the share icon's menu

events.made: You pressed Make a Google Doc of this page in a page's share menu
events.updated: You pressed Update the Google Doc in a page's share menu
events.opened: You pressed Open the Google Doc in a page's share menu or its notice

permissions: reads the page open on the canvas from the workspace when you press Make a Google Doc of this page
makes a Google Doc of it in the connected Google account's Drive, or puts the page into the one made before, and gives you edit access when that account is not your own
touches.remove: Turn the switch page_gdoc off on its row in Evolution, Mutations, and the section is gone from the share menu; the Google Docs it made stay in Drive. To remove it for good revert night 21's commit (rouh/page_gdoc.py, rouh/web/page_gdoc.py and its route in rouh/project/urls.py, Drive.import_html in rouh/google_api/drive.py, the gdocSection in rouh/templates/rouh/index.html, the gdoc code in runs.js, the gdoc icon in menu.js, this manifest) and delete the user setting page_gdoc.
